features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Staggered 15-Head Layout
items.desc: Three-group staggered arrangement of 15 Epson i3200-A1 heads maximises nozzle coverage per pass, delivering faster output at higher quality than a straight linear configuration.

items.title: Linear Motor with Maglev Rail
items.desc: Magnetic levitation linear motor paired with a precision mute rail enables smooth, high-speed carriage movement with minimal vibration and reduced operational noise across long production shifts.

items.title: Static-Free Fluororubber Rollers
items.desc: Imported fluororubber rollers eliminate static build-up that causes ink misting and paper shift, ensuring stable, accurate media feeding even on lightweight sublimation transfer papers.

items.title: Auto Moisture and Cleaning System
items.desc: Sealed automatic printhead moisture control and cleaning cycle maintains consistent nozzle performance throughout the production day without manual intervention.

items.title: Intelligent Drying System with 3-Colour Light Alarm
items.desc: Smart heat management accelerates drying at all print speeds while the three-colour status alarm gives operators instant visual feedback on machine status and production workflow.

items.title: Industrial Servo-Drive Reducer
items.desc: High-precision servo-driven feed and take-up system delivers stable, consistent media transport across long production runs without tension fluctuations or registration drift.

items.title: Broad Software Compatibility
items.desc: Supports Maintop, FlexiPRINT, ONYX, and neoStampa RIP software, giving operators the flexibility to work with their preferred production workflow tools without system changes.

items.title: Fully Enclosed Machine Body
items.desc: Sealed enclosure reduces airborne ink misting and environmental contamination, maintaining cleaner operating conditions and protecting internal components during sustained high-speed production.

items.title: Variable Drop Ink Technology (VSDT)
items.desc: The Epson i3200-A1 printheads use variable drop ink technology with 3,200 nozzles and up to four levels of grayscale, enhancing print resolution and colour restoration.

items.title: Imported THK Mute Guide Rail
items.desc: A Japanese THK mute guide rail ensures steady movement, extended working life, and reduced noise and mechanical resistance during high-speed printing.

items.title: High-Precision Machined Printer Beam
items.desc: An enlarged and widened machine beam design provides superior structural strength, ensuring smoother and more stable printing operations.

items.title: Specialized Thin-Paper Rubber Roller
items.desc: Custom-engineered paper transmission roller optimised for thin paper, enabling flawless, wrinkle-free printing on ultra-light 20–30g transfer paper.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.
